basic_info.description: Two level, single family alt with ultimate Easy Living at the Beach! Stylishly remodeled 4bd/3ba (3bd/2ba on ONE LEVEL!!) + MASSIVE LOW MAINTENANCE BACKYARD, DECK + THREE CAR PARKING! Larger than most single families, w/far more upgrades + systems. Simply move right in, w/out all the additional costs to do these upgrades yourself $$. Maximum convenience- Positioned b/w established Outer Richmond, Sutro Heights + Seacliff- JUST 2 blocks to Balboa Village! Start your morning w/ a surf/bike/run/walk to the beach, GG Park, Lands End Trails, museums, golf courses. At night, walk steps to popular Balboa Village for dinner + a flick at the iconic Balboa Theater- playing cult classics w/beverages (also various restos/parklets/wellness/cafes). Some of the best simple pleasures outside your doorstep, incl Outer Sunset + Clement St. mins away. Open floor plan w/ f/p. Quiet back bds, custom closets + partial ocean views. Primary w/ample closet space + a spa-like bath. Seamlessly integrated family/media room down, w/ addt'l large bed/bath, expansive utility room, w/d, 2nd refrigerator for entertaining off the Exclusive Deck + Enormous Low-Maintenance Backyard. Soak the sun or take in the fresh coastal air! Storage, EV garage parking. A single family home buyer will regret not seeing this one!
